1760	It's true that there is a root of the vessels there, because we never grasp even the light
1761	in itself.
1762	The light always arrives with a garment.
1763	The light in itself is like His Essence; we don't know what it is.
1764	More than that, Baal HaSulam says that the light, even the light revealed in creation, before it comes to receiving,
1765	the light that spreads out from His Essence, has the same status as His Essence.
1766	Only when it is clothed in a vessel can we speak about it.
1767	Since we are created beings, and all our perception is through the vessels.
1768	Therefore there is no image in Ein Sof.
1769	Why?
1770	Because there is no sensation of vessels there.
1771	There are no vessels.
1772	There is only a root for all of them.
1773	And it is abstract; we have no grasp of it, we don't know how to distinguish.
1774	Illumination, vitality and causation as one in the day.
1775	Like the Rosh of the partzuf, like the world of Atzilut.
1776	From the aspect of
1777	the general, the particulars are not discernible there.
1778	All things and the existence in the world come from the letters, that is, from malchut.
1779	For existence is due to malchut.
1780	HaShem wanted His kingship to be revealed in the world, and so He created the will from nothing into something.
1781	All the wills, that is, the images, and all existence, that is, the aspect of malchut, receive their life from the will of Ein Sof.
1782	That is, from His will to do good to His creatures, the thought of creation, where everything exists; we only reveal what
1783	exists there.
1784	Everything flows from the original will to do good to His creatures, this is the thought of creation, what
1785	was, what will be, everything already exists, everything is ready; we only reveal what exists.
1786	We invent nothing, we only reveal what exists anyway, we are only partners
1787	in what is already there.
1788	But when we act on the particulars, it gives us the possibility of partnership, for after all
1789	we invent nothing; the general exists.
1790	HaShem is King, He does not need us in order to be King, but by our revealing this
1791	from our side, we become partners in the matter.
1792	All existence, that is, from the aspect of malchut, receives its life from the will of Ein Sof.
1793	As they said, wherever you find the greatness of the Holy One, blessed be He, that is, His kingship,
1794	that is, wills, there you find His humility, that is, the will of Ein Sof.
1795	That is, where will you find greatness?
1796	Precisely from within the aspect of Ayin.
1797	Where will you find knowledge?
1798	Precisely from within faith.
1799	Where will you find the revelation of creation?
